verdict.rationale: Xero provides a robust, well-documented public API with OpenAPI specs, official SDKs (xero-node), a full developer portal, and OAuth2.0 security schema, enabling AI-native developers to programmatically drive the product. It also ships an official MCP server and AI toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain) explicitly for agentic access, corroborated by a documented endpoint (xero-probe-2). Missing for 10: no llms.txt file (404 confirmed) and no independent third-party hands-on report validating API robustness beyond vendor docs.
